column1: # The CSS states the browser checks never load (Replikanti/interviewscam#61,
# ADR-0003 part 6 amendment): site rules (a) to (d) on the built stylesheet
# (one closed list of @media preludes, braces, value functions, viewport
# units) and markup rule (p) (no <noscript>), one row per refused form and
# position, on a copy of site/pass-built-pins (site_cases_runner in
# tools/selftest.sh, mode css: an edited stylesheet is renamed to its new
# SHA-256 and relinked, the built pins off). Columns: name, file (relative to
# the case), find (exactly one occurrence), replace, expect (PASS, or a text
# the findings must hold). \u{XXXX} in find and replace is that code point.
